blocks.text: You're standing in the middle of the school corridor, holding a flashlight that barely illuminates the darkness. At the far end stands a girl. Long hair. School uniform. A small bracelet around her wrist. You know that face. You've seen it in photographs, in old messages, and in the memories that have haunted you for the past year. It's Lucy. [sigh]Your best friend. The girl who disappeared without a trace one year ago. Your flashlight trembles in your hand.

blocks.text: You stare at her. An hour ago? You remember the school being crowded. You remember walking through the gate. You remember the dark clouds, the deafening roar, and every light going out. But Lucy was supposed to have been missing for an entire year. You slowly raise your phone and open the gallery.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You and Lucy, standing together outside the school. You turn the screen toward her.

blocks.speaker: Protagonist
blocks.text: "Do you remember this?"

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: She looks at the photograph.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "Of course I do. That was last month."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You shake your head.

blocks.speaker: Protagonist
blocks.text: "That was the last picture we took together. It was a year ago."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy's smile fades. She takes the phone from your hand and examines the date. Her face goes pale.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "That's impossible."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You pull the phone back and open the calendar. The date is correct.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A full year has passed since Lucy disappeared.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: But to her, barely an hour has gone by. Neither of you speaks.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Then Lucy notices something on the screen. Your battery is almost dead. She pulls out her own phone. The display lights up. The date is the same as yours.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: But the time is different. Not by a few minutes. By exactly fifty-nine minutes. You compare the two screens.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: For a moment, the only sound is the faint buzzing of your flashlight.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Then Lucy whispers something that makes your stomach drop.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "I remember the clouds."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You look at her.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "What clouds?"

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "The dark ones. They appeared while I was walking home."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: She swallows.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "And then I heard that sound."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The same roar. The same impossible sound that had shaken the school windows. Lucy looks down the corridor.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "I ran back inside. I thought something was happening outside."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You step closer to her.

blocks.speaker: Protagonist
blocks.text: "Then how did you get here?"

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "I don't know."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: She looks at the classroom doors.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "I opened my eyes, and I was standing here."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Suddenly, a bell rings. Both of you jump.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The sound echoes through the building, loud and metallic. You turn toward the main entrance.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The door that refused to move moments ago is now standing slightly open.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A thin strip of pale light shines through the gap. You and Lucy exchange a glance. Then you walk toward it. Together. You push the door open. And stop.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Outside, there is no road. No buildings. No trees.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The entire school grounds have disappeared.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Beyond the entrance stretches an endless field of grey mist, illuminated by a pale, colourless sky.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The school stands alone in the middle of nothing. You step back inside. Lucy grips your arm.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "Where are we?"

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You don't answer. Because for the first time since this began, you realise something worse than being trapped. You might not be anywhere at all.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You return to the main corridor.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy keeps looking over her shoulder, as though expecting someone to emerge from the classrooms. You decide to search the school.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: There has to be an explanation. A broken power supply. Some kind of gas leak. Maybe you're both unconscious somewhere, dreaming the same nightmare.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Anything is better than the alternative.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You check the principal's office first. The door is unlocked.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Inside, papers are scattered across the desk. A chair lies on its side. The computer monitor is dark.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You move the flashlight across the wall.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A clock hangs above the filing cabinet. Its hands are frozen at 3:17. You check your phone. 3:17.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy's phone displays the same time now. You look at the clock again. Its second hand begins to move. One tick. Then another.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The fluorescent light above the desk flickers on. A printer starts running by itself.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You and Lucy stare at it as a single sheet of paper slowly emerges. You walk over and pick it up. It's an attendance sheet. Today's date is printed at the top.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Below it are the names of every student in your class. You scan the list. Your name is there. Lucy's name is there, too.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: But beside both names, someone has written the same word. PRESENT. You turn the sheet over.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: On the back, written in thick black ink, are four words. DO NOT RING THE BELL.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A bell rings somewhere in the building. Once. Twice. Three times. The lights go out.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: From the corridor comes the sound of hundreds of students talking.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Footsteps rush past the office door. Someone laughs.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A teacher shouts for everyone to get back to class.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: For a brief moment, the school sounds exactly as it did before everyone vanished. Lucy looks toward the doorway.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "Can you hear them?"

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You nod. Then you hear your own voice among the crowd. Not your current voice. Your voice from an hour ago. Laughing. Talking. Walking through the school gate.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You slowly approach the office door.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Through the narrow window, you see students passing by.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: They're moving normally, carrying bags and chatting with their friends. Then you see yourself. Walking down the corridor.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The same clothes. The same backpack. The same expression you wore before the sky turned dark.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Your past self walks directly past the office.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: And behind you, walking toward the school gate, is Lucy. She looks exactly as she does now. Lucy grabs your shoulder.

blocks.speaker: Protagonist
blocks.text: "That's me."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: On the other side of the glass, your past self stops walking.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You watch as he looks up at the dark clouds. Then he runs toward the entrance. The image flickers.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The corridor outside becomes empty again. The voices stop. The lights remain off. You turn toward Lucy. She is staring at the window.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Tears are running down her face.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "I remember this."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You wait.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "I remember seeing you run inside. I thought you were scared of the storm."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: She wipes her eyes.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "Then I heard the roar. Everything went black."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: She looks at you.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "And then I was here."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You glance at the attendance sheet. PRESENT. Both of you.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: As though the school has been waiting for you to arrive.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: As though it knows exactly where you belong. ________________

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A crackling sound comes from the loudspeaker above the office door. You freeze.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The school's announcement system hasn't worked since the lights went out.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Static fills the corridor. Then a familiar voice speaks. It's the principal.

blocks.speaker: Principal
blocks.text: "Attention, students."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The voice is distorted, as though coming from a damaged recording.

blocks.speaker: Principal
blocks.text: "Please proceed to your assigned classrooms."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You and Lucy remain still. The announcement repeats.

blocks.speaker: Principal
blocks.text: "Please proceed to your assigned classrooms."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Then the voice changes. It becomes quieter. Almost a whisper.

blocks.speaker: Principal
blocks.text: "Lucy?"

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: She stops breathing for a moment. The speaker crackles.

blocks.speaker: Principal
blocks.text: "Lucy, please report to the principal's office."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You look at her. She shakes her head.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "I don't want to."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A long burst of static fills the air. Then the principal's voice returns.

blocks.speaker: Principal
blocks.text: "Lucy, your parents are waiting."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy backs away from the speaker.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: “No.”

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The announcement continues.

blocks.speaker: Principal
blocks.text: “They have been waiting for one year.”

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You stare at Lucy. She looks just as terrified as you feel. The loudspeaker clicks off.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: For several seconds, neither of you moves.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Then a phone rings somewhere inside the office. You turn toward the desk. Your phone is in your hand. Lucy's phone is in her pocket.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The ringing comes from the dark computer beneath the desk. You crouch down.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: An old landline phone sits beside a stack of files. Its display is glowing.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The caller ID reads: LUCY'S HOME.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy steps closer.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "That's my house."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The phone keeps ringing. You pick up the receiver.

blocks.speaker: Protagonist
blocks.text: "Hello?"

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: For a moment, there is only static. Then a woman's voice speaks.

blocks.speaker: Lucy's Mother
blocks.text: "Lucy?"

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You turn toward her. Lucy's eyes widen. It's her mother.

blocks.text: The voice sounds distant, exhausted, and desperate.

blocks.speaker: Lucy's Mother
blocks.text: "Lucy, sweetheart, where are you?"
blocks.cachedSig: fish_s2__"Lucy, sweetheart, where are you?"__voice_scarlett__[crying][desperate][trembling voice]__voices/reference/scarlett_johansson.wav__0.70__0.85____1.00__1.00__0.0__0.0__0.0__0.00__radio

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy reaches for the receiver. You hand it to her.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "Mum?"

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A sharp breath comes through the line.

blocks.speaker: Lucy's Mother
blocks.text: "Oh, thank God."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy's mother begins crying.

blocks.speaker: Lucy's Mother
blocks.text: "Where have you been? We've been looking for you everywhere."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy presses the receiver against her ear.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "Mum, I don't understand. I was only gone for an hour."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Silence.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Then her mother whispers:

blocks.speaker: Lucy's Mother
blocks.text: "Lucy, you've been missing for a year."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy drops the receiver. It swings from the cord, knocking against the desk. You look at her. She looks at you.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Neither of you needs to say anything. The phone line goes dead.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Then, from somewhere deep inside the school, comes the sound of a classroom door opening. A chair scraping across the floor.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: And a teacher calling for attendance. ________________ You grab Lucy's hand.

blocks.speaker: Protagonist
blocks.text: "We need to leave."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You run toward the main entrance. This time, the door opens easily.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Beyond it, the endless grey field is gone. The road is back. The buildings are back.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The trees stand motionless beneath the dark sky.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: But the streets are completely empty. You step outside. Lucy follows.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: For the first time since the nightmare began, you can breathe without feeling trapped. You start running toward home. The road stretches ahead of you. No cars.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: No people. No movement. You pass the shops near the school. Their shutters are closed. Traffic lights blink over deserted intersections.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Your phone loses its signal completely. Lucy's phone does the same. Then you reach a familiar crossing. You stop. Across the road stands a bus.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Its doors are open.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The interior lights glow softly.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A few students sit inside, staring straight ahead. You recognise their uniforms. They're students from your school. You run toward the bus.

blocks.speaker: Protagonist
blocks.text: "Hey! Help us!"

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Nobody responds. You reach the open doors.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Every student turns toward you at exactly the same time.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Their faces are pale and expressionless.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: At the back of the bus sits a girl wearing a school uniform.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Her hair falls across her shoulders. A small bracelet circles her wrist. You look at Lucy. Lucy is standing beside you.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The girl on the bus has the same face. The same eyes. The same clothes. Another Lucy.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The girl inside slowly raises her head. Then she smiles. The bus doors slam shut. The engine starts.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You watch as the vehicle drives away into the dark. Lucy doesn't move. You turn toward her. She is staring at her bracelet.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Her fingers tremble as she tries to pull it off. It won't come loose. She looks up at you.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: There's something I didn't tell you.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You wait.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: When I disappeared, I wasn't alone.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Her voice breaks.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "I saw someone standing in the road."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You feel the blood drain from your face.

blocks.speaker: Protagonist
blocks.text: "Who?"

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Lucy looks toward the direction the bus disappeared.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "You."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: The sky begins to roar again. The streetlights flicker.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: And every clock in the city stops at exactly 3:17. Lucy grips your hand.

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: "I think,

blocks.speaker: Lucy
blocks.text: we were never supposed to come back."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Behind you, the school bell rings. Once. Twice. Three times.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: Then the loudspeaker crackles to life.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A voice speaks through the darkness.

blocks.speaker: Principal
blocks.text: "Attention, students."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: A pause.

blocks.speaker: Principal
blocks.text: "One student is still missing."

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: You turn toward the school. In an upstairs classroom window, someone is standing behind the glass. Watching you. It's you. Your past self.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: He raises one hand and presses it against the window. Then the lights go out.

blocks.speaker: Narrator
blocks.text: And somewhere in the darkness, you hear a door open. End.
